clips.tip: Look for the pale stripe on the rear half of the body. Colour alone isn't reliable in green, murky water.
Lingcod are longer and thinner than rockfish, with a huge mouth.
Greenlings have one long dorsal fin, not the separate spiny fin of a rockfish.
A quillback's dorsal spines are much taller and more ragged.
